content.title: Insurer Centene Stock Spikes on Earnings. There’s Still a Long Road to Recovery
content.summary: Shares of the embattled health insurer  Centene  jumped almost 8% on Wednesday after medical costs for its Medicaid plans came in below expectations, leaving it with better-than-expected third quarter results.  Shares plummeted 40% in a single day in early July when the company withdrew its 2025 financial guidance, citing worries about the plans it offers on the Affordable Care Act exchanges.  Since then, the stock has been “bouncing near the bottom like a pogo stick in an infinity pool,” as  Mizuho  healthcare equity strategist Jared Holz put it in an email to investors early Wednesday.
